today.title: Budget will unveil 70 billion borrowing to pay welfare bill, city experts warns
today.debunk: DWP total 309.5bn but 146.2bn is State Pension (47%). UC 424.90/mo. Borrowing driven by interest rates/growth/tax, not claimants. PIP fraud 0.4%.

today.title: John Healey plans to send 2,000 anti-fraud experts into Jobcentres to claw back 1.4bn from benefits cheats
today.debunk: 1.4bn = 0.45% of 309.5bn spend. Fraud & error ~2.8% (mostly error). PIP fraud 0.4%. Taper 55%, WA 427/710. 70% PIP tribunals overturn DWP. 19bn unclaimed vs 1.4bn target.
